newsitem.title: GERMANY: Strabag says plans to sell Deutag stake.
newsitem.headline: Strabag says plans to sell Deutag stake.

text.p: German contruction company Strabag AG said on Tuesday it planned to sell its majority stake in its subsidiary Deutag AG to Basalt AG in order to balance its books in 1996.

"In order to be prepared for the hard competition next year in the building industry, Strabag will on the one hand mobilise capital and on the other side promote new cooperation and partnerships," said Strabag in a statement.

Strabag said group operating losses would be less than in 1995, but still show a loss rather than a profit, due to high costs for structural improvements, in particular the closure of loss-making branches and the linked social costs.
The firm said it aimed to at least break even in 1997, through structural improvement and balance sheet measures, despite difficult market conditions.
